kb.title: Knowledge
kb.lead: What the project knows: decisions, procedures and references. People and bots read and write the same pages.

write.title: Write it
write.body: Edit in the editor below: it saves by itself. To create a page, write its name in double brackets, for example [[Decisions]], and click the link.

ask.title: Ask a bot
ask.body: A bot with access reads these pages before working and updates them when you ask.
ask.example: Document in the knowledge base how we deploy to production.
ask.none: This project has no bots yet.
ask.giveTip: Opens the bot's profile: switch the project-knowledge skill on and apply the changes.

files.title: Bring what you already have
files.body: Copy Markdown files (.md) into this project folder. They show up here right away and bots see them too.

kb.note: Each page is a file in project/wiki/ and enters the project history with the backup (Git). Do not store passwords or keys.
kb.unavailable: The knowledge base is not available. Check in Apps that it is running.
